screen.not_sent: Not sent: may the screen perform actions?

app.name: Proxmox
app.summary: A Proxmox node's status, CPU, memory and disk, a card with its last day and keys to control it, and an alert when something goes down.
app.status_hint: Whether it runs: a binary sensor, or a sensor that says running, online or up.
app.percent_hint: A sensor in %, drawn as a bar. Another unit shows as a value without a bar.
app.list_example: 6 of 7 online: the NAS is down
app.item_hint: A VM, a container or a service: a binary sensor (on is up, or on is a problem for one of device class problem), or a sensor that says up, running or online.
app.keys_hint: Button entities of the node or guest. A tap on the tile opens its card with these keys; each asks once more before it acts.
app.input_problem_hint: A binary sensor that is on while something is down, with the names of what is down in its attribute problems (see the README).
app.saver_example: Only while something is down: what, large
app.setting_popup_hint: Show a popup over the screen when something goes down.
app.names_hint: Your own names for the chosen entities, in the order they are chosen, separated by commas: Arco, Docker, NAS. Leave a place empty (Arco,,NAS) to keep that entity's name. Without them, a name loses a trailing Status and a number in brackets.
